name_note: In GTDB, Enterococcus_A is a split of the classical genus Enterococcus that holds the Enterococcus avium group, including E. avium, E. raffinosus, E. gilvus and E. malodoratus, and not E. faecalis or E. faecium.

sentences.text: A strain isolated from human gut microbiota and identified as Enterococcus avium was reported to cleave C-glycosidic bonds, converting flavonoid 8-C-glycosides such as orientin and vitexin to their aglycones.
A genome announcement reported Enterococcus raffinosus strain MEBT1 isolated from the feces of children with diarrhea in Bangladesh.
A case series describes Enterococcus avium as an extremely rare cause of brain abscess, with only a limited number of cases reported to date.
Whole-genome sequencing of four multidrug-resistant Enterococcus avium strains from milk, feces and farm soil of mastitic dairy cows has also been reported.
